text:
Situation: Ondansetron hydrochloride is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Current inventory coverage varies by site. Corvale East holds 174 tablets of the 4 mg presentation at 8.3 per day for 21 days and 165 tablets at 7.2 per day for 23 days. Corvale General holds 132 tablets at 8.6 per day for 15.4 days and 266 tablets at 8.9 per day for 29.9 days. Corvale Lakeside holds 46 tablets at 1.6 per day for 28.6 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows ondansetron hydrochloride is not listed as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: No national shortage exists per FDA. Corvale General's 132-tablet supply (15.4 days) falls below typical internal reorder thresholds. Other sites have adequate coverage. Ranked alternate manufacturers Ascend Laboratories, LLC, Aurobindo Pharma Limited, AvKARE, AvPAK, and BluePoint Laboratories are not on FDA's shortage list today, but their labels name no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to verify each site's specific reorder point and place replenishment orders for Corvale General immediately; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to request current allocation and lead-time quotes from Ascend Laboratories, LLC, Aurobindo Pharma Limited, AvKARE, AvPAK, and BluePoint Laboratories; requires Purchasing Manager approval.
3. Buyer to confirm plant location and supply reliability for each alternate manufacturer before committing orders; requires Quality Assurance approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
